decision.reason: CLAUDE-G01H-V8-MF1 stands. basedOn.predecessorV1.role routes the reader who wants the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement to 'this v7' — a frozen, dual-REJECTed predecessor — applying a v7 speaker label to a v8 subject and recording v7 as the current occupancy remasurement. This trips the subject's own failsIf[7] and failsIf[24], contradicts doesNot[14] and proposedLaterWork[10], and is a regression of the exact defect class that both reviewers already landed as CLAUDE-G01H-V6-MF1 / CODEX-G01H-V6-MF1 against this same field.
decision.recommendation: DO-NOT-SEAL. Do not record as-is. Every other measured content check passed byte-exactly; the defect is a single missed node in the v7-to-v8 speaker sweep, in the one field with a documented history of carrying exactly this failure.

findings.title: basedOn.predecessorV1.role routes the live-HEAD occupancy-remasurement reader to 'this v7', applying a v7 speaker label to a v8 subject and recording frozen dual-REJECTed v7 as the current occupancy — the same field and the same defect class that landed as CLAUDE-G01H-V6-MF1 / CODEX-G01H-V6-MF1, now regressed one version forward
findings.quotedBytes: A reader who wants the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement after D-173 / D-230 reads this v7.

measured.fieldFullValue: Frozen v1. Occupies CGHS v4's artifactPathWhenAuthored (docs/coop/artifacts/harness.DR-G01.core-download.v1.json). Carries the byte-equal harness object to CGHS v4's DR-G01 entry. Claude ACCEPT 0/0 at review digest c2339ec68b490eba7b97f1a2890de967f6a1426deb54aeac3165dee82117b846. Codex not reviewed. v1 is the thin extraction occupying the promised path. This v8 is occupancy remasurement of the unversioned identifier harness.DR-G01.core-download at live HEAD after leftover-join.v7 / required-now 28. A reader who wants the CGHS promised-path occupancy reads v1. A reader who wants the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement after D-173 / D-230 reads this v7. v1 is not this artifact's version number and is not recordable as a current occupancy remasurement at live HEAD.
measured.speakerSweepEvidence: v7-to-v8 diff of this single field shows exactly one substitution: 'This v7 is occupancy remasurement' -> 'This v8 is occupancy remasurement'. The second speaker token in the same string, 'reads this v7', was left at its v7 value. In the v7 subject that token was correct (v7 was then the speaker); in the v8 subject it is stale.
measured.fullSweepResult: A sweep of every string field in the subject for /[Tt]his v[0-9]+/ returns 26 hits. Every hit resolves to the current speaker 'v8' or sits inside an explicit quotation or failure-condition frame (failsIf[24], failsIf[28], failsIf[30], failsIf[31], failsIf[32], and basedOn.predecessorV7.role's reported speech 'predecessorV5.role still said land in this v6'). basedOn.predecessorV1.role's 'reads this v7' is the sole unframed, assertive stale speaker token in the document.

whyItStands: failsIf[24] of this same subject reads: 'speaker labels say This v1, This v2, This v3, This v4, This v5, This v6, or This v7 for this subject'. v8 newly extended that roster to include 'This v7' in this very revision, and then trips it.

failsIf[7] of this same subject reads: 'v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, or v7 is recorded as a current occupancy remasurement'. The sentence names the destination for 'the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement after D-173 / D-230' — the currency question — and answers it with v7.
doesNot[14] reads: 'Does not record frozen v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, or v7 as a current occupancy remasurement.' The sentence does exactly that.
proposedLaterWork[10] reads: 'Frozen v7 remains a historical occupancy that was dual REJECT. Do not record v7 as current.' The routing sentence directly contradicts it inside the same file.
basedOn.predecessorV7.role reads: 'Not recordable as a current occupancy remasurement.' The routing sentence makes v7 the recorded current occupancy for the live-HEAD reader.

Internal contradiction within one string: the sentence two positions earlier asserts 'This v8 is occupancy remasurement of the unversioned identifier harness.DR-G01.core-download at live HEAD after leftover-join.v7 / required-now 28.' Two adjacent sentences give two different answers to the same question.

The destination is not merely stale, it is disqualified: basedOn.predecessorV7.reviews record 'REJECT 0 blockers / 1 MUST-FIX CLAUDE-G01H-V7-MF1' and 'REJECT 1 MUST-FIX CODEX-G01H-V7-MF1'. Both digests were verified against the pinned review bytes. The subject routes live-HEAD currency readers to a dual-REJECTed artifact.

This is a regression, not a new slip. failsIf[30] of this same subject names the class verbatim: 'CLAUDE-G01H-V6-MF1 / CODEX-G01H-V6-MF1 is not landed (predecessorV1.role still routes live-HEAD occupancy readers to this v5)'. The v6 finding bytes were verified: Claude's V6-MF1 title reads 'basedOn.predecessorV1.role routes the reader who wants the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement to "this v5"', and Codex's V6-MF1 title reads 'predecessorV1.role directs readers seeking the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement to frozen REJECTed v5 instead of the v6 subject'. Same field, same sentence, same shape, shifted two versions.

refutationsAttempted.attack: 'reads this v7' may be a legitimate historical or quotational reference, like basedOn.predecessorV7.role's 'still said land in this v6'.
refutationsAttempted.result: REFUTED. predecessorV7.role frames its token in reported speech with an explicit attributive ('predecessorV5.role still said...'), and failsIf[28]/[30]/[31]/[32] frame theirs as named prior failure conditions. The predecessorV1.role occurrence carries no quotation frame, no attributive, and no failure-condition framing. It is a bare assertive directive in the subject's own voice, grammatically parallel to the immediately preceding legitimate directive 'A reader who wants the CGHS promised-path occupancy reads v1.'

refutationsAttempted.attack: Perhaps v7 genuinely is the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement after D-173 / D-230, making the sentence factually correct.
refutationsAttempted.result: REFUTED by the subject's own bytes at four independent sites: basedOn.predecessorV7.role ('Not recordable as a current occupancy remasurement'), doesNot[14], failsIf[7], and proposedLaterWork[10]. The subject also asserts the contrary in the same string. v7 and v8 pin the identical head, the identical file08Pin, and the identical required-now 28, so v7 cannot be distinguished as the live-HEAD reading on measurement grounds either — the only discriminator is currency, and the subject resolves currency to v8 everywhere except here.

refutationsAttempted.attack: 'this v7' may denote distribution-core leftover-join.v7 rather than harness v7, in which case no speaker label is involved.
refutationsAttempted.result: REFUTED. The sentence's subject is 'the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement', and the subject states at whatThisCloses.leftoverNameNote that 'This file is occupancy remasurement of the already-named G01 identifier, not a leftover-join', and at basedOn.leftoverJoinV7.role that 'distribution-core leftover-join and G01 harness occupancy are different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated.' leftover-join.v7 is therefore not a candidate occupancy remasurement. The demonstrative 'this' marks a speaker self-label, parallel to 'This v8 is occupancy remasurement' earlier in the same field. Decisively, the v6 predecessor of this identical sentence read 'reads this v5', where no leftover-join v5 reading was available and both independent reviewers read it as the harness lineage.

refutationsAttempted.attack: The defect may be cosmetic and therefore SHOULD-FIX rather than MUST-FIX.
refutationsAttempted.result: REFUTED. The sentence is the subject's routing instruction for the currency question — the single question this artifact exists to answer. It trips two of the subject's own published failure conditions (failsIf[7], failsIf[24]) and contradicts two published non-claims (doesNot[14], basedOn.predecessorV7.role). An artifact failed by its own published failure conditions on its central claim is not cosmetic. The lineage has also graded this exact class MUST-FIX three times running: CLAUDE-G01H-V6-MF1, CODEX-G01H-V6-MF1, CLAUDE-G01H-V7-MF1, CODEX-G01H-V7-MF1.

refutationsAttempted.attack: The stated v8 fix (CLAUDE-G01H-V7-MF1 / CODEX-G01H-V7-MF1) may itself have failed to land, which would be an additional finding.
refutationsAttempted.result: REFUTED — the stated fix did land. basedOn.predecessorV5.role now reads 'CLAUDE-G01H-V4-MF1 and CLAUDE-G01H-V4-MF2 landed in this lineage at v5. CLAUDE-G01H-V5-MF1 and CLAUDE-G01H-V5-SF1 landed in this lineage at v6.' — the historical form the prompt describes. predecessorV4.role and predecessorV6.role use the same historical form ('landed in this lineage at v5' / 'at v7'), and predecessorV7.role correctly uses the current-speaker form ('land in this v8'). No finding here.

findings.fixDirection: In basedOn.predecessorV1.role, change 'reads this v7' to 'reads this v8'. No other field requires a speaker change; the full sweep found no other unframed stale token. Consider also restating failsIf[30] in field-general rather than version-locked terms, since a landing-receipt pinned to 'this v5' cannot signal the same defect recurring at 'this v7'.
findings.confidence: CONFIRMED — measured directly from the frozen subject bytes and from the v7-to-v8 field diff; the destination artifact's dual-REJECT standing was confirmed against the pinned review file bytes.
